partnership_announcements.description: OQ Gas Networks signed a hydrogen pipeline cooperation agreement with Belgium’s Fluxys to collaborate on developing hydrogen transport infrastructure as part of Oman’s energy transition.
OQGN, Fluxys and ERNE announced alignment on plans to develop a national hydrogen pipeline network in Oman as part of the government’s common infrastructure plan.

press_references.value: Oman’s gas network to expand to 4,623km by 2027

partnership_announcements.description: OQ Gas Networks awarded Petrojet a contract to build a 42-inch, 193 km gas pipeline from Fahud to Suhar, budgeted at about OMR 105 million, to boost supply to Suhar and serve the Ibri industrial hub.

press_references.value: OQGN awards RO 105m gas pipeline contract

partnership_announcements.description: OQ Gas Networks awarded a RO 105 million engineering, procurement, and construction contract for the Second Loop Line Fahud-Suhar gas pipeline project to Petroleum Projects Company Petrojet and Partners, and a related supply contract to Jindal Saw Limited.

press_references.value: 10 projects underway to boost Oman’s gas transportation capacity: OQGN

partnership_announcements.description: OQGN has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Oxy Oman to provide regulatory and infrastructure support for hydrogen pipelines in Oman, positioning OQGN as the National Infrastructure Provider for Hydrogen (H₂) pipelines.

overview_description.description: OQGN is the sole operator of the gas transportation system in Oman and it serves as the Sultanate's vital company and infrastructure supplier, making up the core of the nation's energy ecosystem.

awards.description: OQ Gas Networks received three national honors in 2025: Best CEO, Best Employer Brand, and the Green Future Leadership Award, recognizing its leadership, workplace practices, and sustainability efforts.

press_references.value: OQGN sets GCC benchmark with ISO 50001 certification

awards.description: OQ Gas Networks received ISO 50001 Energy Management System certification, becoming the first midstream gas transmission company in the GCC to achieve this energy management standard.
